c1.note: Anduril's own IR page, NPM and TradingView (IPO only 'rumored' as of Nov 11, 2026) all show it is private. Every variant A-E says the same thing.

c2.note: Quoted from Anduril's investor relations page.

c3.note: The IR page and SmartAsset (no standard retail brokerage access) support this. The exact retail wording is not in the excerpt.

c7.note: Anduril remains private with no ticker per SmartAsset (October 2026). The TradingView NASDAQ-ANDURIL page is a placeholder.

c8.note: SmartAsset says 'privately held as of October 2026, with no publicly announced IPO date or stock ticker.'

c10.note: The article, updated Oct 20, 2026, says no S-1 has been filed. SmartAsset says the same as of October 2026.

c12.note: The TradingView text is quoted directly, including the Nov 11, 2026 date.

c13.note: The page shows 'No trades' and an IPO status of rumored, so it is a placeholder. The word 'placeholder' is an inference.

c14.note: NPM treats these as unregistered private company securities and offers its services only to accredited investors.

c16.note: NPM page states price estimate as of October 28, 2026, which matches the update date claimed.

c17.note: 'Only on Forge' is too narrow: shares are also available via Nasdaq Private Market, EquityZen and SPVs, so the 'only such as Forge' wording is misleading though private-only is true.

c18.note: Anduril's own May 13, 2026 release confirms $5B Series H, $61B valuation, led by Thrive and a16z.

c22.note: Reuters July 2026 report of ~$100B talks, described as fluid with no decisions made.

c24.note: CNBC confirms tender offer valuing company at roughly $90B.

c25.note: Opened Oct 13, closes Nov 9, $94.80/share, capped at $1.3B; matches CNBC/Bloomberg.

c26.note: Private-market tender part is right, but CNBC says Anduril confirmed the report, contradicting 'did not publicly confirm'.

c28.note: Employee tender of private shares; Anduril remains private with no S-1 filed, so not a public listing.

c29.note: Tender was confirmed by Anduril and has closed (Nov 9); it is just not a priced funding round, so 'not confirmed' wording is misleading.

c30.note: Luckey said 'definitely' go public in 2025 and suggested an IPO within 'low single-digit years'; no S-1 filed.

c32.note: Everything-PR states Schimpf said in July 2026 that an IPO in a hype cycle would be a mistake; single secondary source, no primary quote.

c34.note: Anduril's IR page warns about third parties offering 'pre-IPO Anduril shares' and reports apparently fraudulent schemes, but explicitly does not say every such firm is fraudulent, so 'very likely scams' slightly overstates it.

c15.note: NPM page says Anduril stock does not trade on public exchanges. It says you can buy shares directly through the company or via a secondary marketplace like Nasdaq Private Market. Accredited investors only.

c33.note: Anduril is still private. As of Nov 11, 2026 TradingView lists its IPO as 'rumored' with 'No trades'. c9.note: As of late Oct/Nov 2026, Anduril is still private. It has no S-1 filing and has announced no IPO date or ticker.
